metadata.author: Benjiman Jennings
metadata.title: Dental Decision Memo — FHIR Priority
metadata.demo_effect: Codifies the leadership decision to prioritize FHIR over new feature work.

payload.summary: FHIR migration work becomes the primary priority for Dental / DenClass, deferring new feature work not required to reduce critical-path risk.

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration
decisions.anchorText: Effective immediately, FHIR migration work becomes the primary priority for Dental / DenClass.

decisions.label: defer non-critical feature work
decisions.anchorText: New feature work not required to reduce critical-path risk is deferred.

warnings: This decision remains in force until leadership revisits the vendor dependency posture on or after April 15, 2026.
